caption: The drawing depicts a heating pan with a long wooden handle and a round metal pan. The pan is shown from multiple angles, including a top view, side view, bottom view, and a perspective that highlights the length of the handle. The pan itself is golden brown with a decorative circular pattern on its lid, featuring a bird among foliage in the center, enclosed by concentric rings and small ornamental dots. The metal pan has a worn appearance with patches of darker coloration, likely to indicate use. The side view also shows the pan's shallow depth and the attachment point of the handle, which is fixed to the pan with two rivets. The handle is long, cylindrical, and textured to resemble wood grain, rendered in shades of brown and reddish-brown. The handle’s tip has a rounded end and a small knob. There are measured lines and scale indicators along the edges of the drawing for dimensional reference, and the illustration is framed with thin, black, rectangular outlines.
title: Warming Pan
